visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige knit cardigan over a greenish-yellow top, sits at a white table. She holds a digital pregnancy test and smiles brightly. A warm desk lamp is visible behind her against neutral curtains. (2) The scene shifts as she gestures with her hands while talking, appearing animated. Text bubbles containing comments from social media appear around her head. (3) She points to a calendar graphic with a red 'X' over it, indicating a 'do not' action. Her expression is helpful and instructional. (4) The woman is shown resting her head on her hand, then a cartoon graphic of a woman resting appears next to her. She continues to gesture and explain while maintaining eye contact with the camera. (5) She presents various supplement packets, including those labeled with 'Fe' and 'Ca', holding them up to the camera to show the labels clearly. (6) She holds up a white square packet (a sanitary pad) with a blue sticker, explaining its significance. Confetti graphics and a pregnancy test icon overlay the screen. (7) She gestures toward the camera with an open hand, then holds the white packet again, concluding her message with a warm smile. A graphic about a giveaway appears at the bottom.
